episode_row: restarted scheduler ignored an already-posted pick (replayed checks, no polling)

commits.subject: fix: recognize externally-locked picks on scheduler restart
commits.body:
When a pick was posted by a previous scheduler instance (or manually),
the restarted scheduler didn't set state.pick_locked — causing it to
replay all check times and skip result polling. Now checks
pick_result.locked after each run_single_check and breaks early.
